title: Shape Address :: Fun Memorable Wallet Address
tagline: Shape-Address makes wallets cute 😍, distinguishable, memorizable, easily transmittable via a voice..
description:
Shape-Address takes a large identifier such as the hexadecimal wallet address and generates a human-friendly representation to it, in a visual form using highly recognizable shapes, symbols and colors.

* Distinguishable, Memorizable, and Simple for comparing and matching,
* Easily transmittable via a voice channel, and allows for quick recovery of the original input string.
* Colorblindness Friendly  

The Picto-Art ‘Colorful Symbols’ output, uses 6-8 basic colors and a set of the most universally recognizable pictogram symbols such as triangles, squares, circles, stars, and hearts etc, as ▲■ ♥ ●

## Use Cases
A common use cases in crypto wallets and dapps as:

* Crypto wallet address placeholder,
* Account Identicon placeholder,
* QR-code check-summing.

and all together in order to enhance the overall visual security, and provides a seamless user experience :P 

Shapes: Keep it real, keep it playful ▲■ ♥ ●
how_its_made:
a JS library, that has this Encoding Dictionary in which encode/decode the large identifier (wallet address or so) and present it as those colorful shapes that can easily recognized

this library can be integrated anywhere the wallet address needed to be presented (instead or next to that address) think QR code or identicon cool to have around wallet address, but this 10x better easier and simpler

the Shapes Address Library can be installed as a Chrome extension in which would generate friendly shapes addresses for wallets across all web3 sites as well as can be an optional part of already existed common extension such as Metamask or brave..
